provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled renewal-demography model with reproduction only at the listed exact ages. Newborn survival is1; only the supplied reproductive ages contribute offspring. Age-specific expected daughters per newborn are l_x*m_x. Intrinsic log growth r uniquely solves sum_x l_x*m_x*exp(-r*x)=1. This equation and source time convention define the model; no stochastic persistence calculation or stable-stage initial condition is requested.
generation_time: The UNDISCOUNTED life-table generation time is sum(x*l_x*m_x)/R0,where R0=sum(l_x*m_x). The requested shortcut is r_approx=ln(R0)/this_generation_time. It need not equal the Euler-Lotka root. Report signed relative error=(shortcut-r)/r for each schedule.
scope: Two complete controlled reproductive schedules with identical lifetime expected offspring but different timing,not fitted real species life histories.
